auditNotes.noteEnglish: The word-level i'rab labels the word an accusative adjective. The ayah note explicitly treats it as a further second object, parallel to the first descriptor. The lesson follows the ayah note and mentions the adjective analysis.

QAC tags the prefixed fa as resumptive in both the segment and word-level i'rab. It links the conditional answer introduced by the restrictive particle, so the answer clause is in a jussive syntactic position while its own imperfect is indicative.
The word-level i'rab labels the final descriptor an accusative adjective. The lesson follows this and mentions the possible analysis as a second predicate of kāna.
Muyassar distinguishes unintended error from deliberate sin, while Sa'di distinguishes a major sin from a lesser one. The translation keeps the distinction open and the tafsir gives both readings.
